title: Jam jam cookies
hookLine: Canadian-inspired jam jam cookies with 12 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Jam jam cookies
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to 350 °F (180 °C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. In a stand mixer with the paddle attachment, cream the butter, white sugar and egg until combined, then add the molasses and vanilla and mix until smooth. Incorporate {m53339_1}, {m53339_2}, {m53339_3}, and {m53339_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure egg first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Once combined, add the baking soda water mixture and mix for another minute to combine. Combine dry ingredients; mix baking powder, cinnamon, flour and salt in a separate bowl then add to the wet ingredients a little at a time, mixing on low until fully combined and scraping down the sides to ensure everything is incorporated. The dough should be easily shaped. Incorporate {m53339_5}, {m53339_6}, {m53339_7}, {m53339_8}, {m53339_9}, {m53339_10}, {m53339_11}, and {m53339_12} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Portion dough with a small spoon, roll them into balls and place them on the lined cookie sheet, press them into flat discs using a floured glass or your moistened palm. Place cookies on parchment-lined baking sheets and bake for 10-12 mins. Remove from the oven and let them cool for at least 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Once cooled the cookie sandwiches by spreading at least two teaspoons of your favourite jam between the two cookies. Repeat and enjoy with a cup of tea.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
